senses.gloss: (II)--a son of प्रतिहर्ता and Stuti. भा. V. १५. 5.
(III)--a Rudra, and a son of भूत and सरूपा. भा. VI. 6. १७.

(IV)--the son of Raghu, and father of दशरथ. (Burnouf makes Aja, son of पृथुश्रवस्. But पृथुश्रवस् here is an adjective of Raghu meaning--highly renowned). भा. IX. १०. 1; Br. III. ६३. १८४; वा. ८८. १८३: Vi. IV. 4. ८५-6. [page१-028+ २५]
(V)--the son of ऊर्ध्वकेतु and father of Purujit. भा. IX. १३. २२.
(VI)--a तुषित god. Br. II. ३६. १०.
(VII)--a son of Uttama Manu. Br. II. ३६. ३९; वा. ६१. १८५; ६२. 9. ३४; Vi. III. 1. १५.
(VIII)--a कूष्माण्ड Pis4a1ca, one of the two sons of कपी. Had a daughter जन्तुधना. Br. III. 7. ७४-85.
(IX)--an attribute of कुमार. Br. III. १०. ४८.
(X)--a सुधमान god. Br. IV. 1. ६०.
(XI)--a horse of the chariot of the moon. M. १२६. ५२.
(XIII)--a son of भृगु. वा. ६५. ८७.
(XIV)--a division of the night. वा. ६६. ४३.
(XV)--the name of a दानव. वा. ६८. ११. [page१-029+ २८]
(XVI)--the name given to Dhanvantari when he first appeared out of the churning of the ocean for nectar. वा. ९२. १०.

--born of यशोदा--माया (s.v);
1: भा. X. 3. ४७; १३. ५२.
the energy of the Creator--through her, Hari is spoken of in nine forms.
2: Ib., XI. 9. २८; XII. ११. ३१.
(XII)--the one god and goddess; mystery of; अजा, eight letters, sixteen hands, and feet, four faces, three knots of hair, one horned goddess--माया. वा. २०. २८-29.
(I)--a son of बलाक and father of कुश. भा. IX. १५. 3-4.

(II)--the son of Sunaha (Suhotra-वा। प्।, and Sumantu-वि। प्।) and father of बलाकाश्व;
1: Br. III. ६६. ३०; ७४-126; वा. ९१. ६०-61; Vi. IV. 7. 8.
ruled for २१ years (३१ ? वा।).
2: वा. ९९. ३१३.
(III)--the son of दिलीप. M. १२. ४८.
--a son of Maya. Br. III. 6. २९.
--a place fit for श्राद्ध offering. M. १५. ३३.
--an Apsaras. Br. III. 7. 8.
--the name of Siva's bow (also आजगवम्). M. २३. ३७; वा. ९०. ३१.

--a place fit for performing श्राद्धम्, noted for the tree विरजा;
1: Br. III. १३. ४८.
the shadow of gods seen at the place in पर्वस्; the पाण्डवस् performed श्राद्धम् at.
2: वा. ७७. ४८.
(I)--the parent of Buddha. (अञ्जन-Burnouf). भा. I. 3. २४.
(II)--a name of कृष्ण-Hari. भा. X. 3. 1 & 5; 6. २३. [page१-030+ ३३]
--a nephew of हिरण्यकशिपु. M. 6. २७.
--the kingdom of ऋषभ, later known as भारत. भा. V. 4. 3; 7. 3; XI. 2. २४.
--a pupil of कृत. Br. II. ३५. ५२.
--one of the nine sons of Ugrasena. M. ४४. ७५.

(I)--a son of Hastin. Had three queens of Kuru line; प्रियमेधा and other ब्राह्मन्स् belonged to his family. Father of कण्व and बृहदिषु.
1: भा. IX. २१. २१-22; वा. ९९. १६६; Vi. IV. १९. २९-30, ३३; M. ४९. ४३-5.
By नलिनी he had a son नील.
2: भा. IX. २१-30; वा. ९९. १९४; Vi. IV. १९. ५६.
ऋक्ष was another son of his.
3: भा. IX. २२. 3; M. ५०. १९. Vi. IV. १९. ७४.
Sons born through the grace of भरद्वाज.
4: वा. ९९. १६९.
(II)--an अङ्गिरस and मन्त्रकृत्। A क्ष- triya-dvija. Br. II. ३२. १०९; III. ६६. ८७; M. १४५. १०३; वा. ९१. ११६; ५९. १००.
--a mindborn mother. M. १७९. २४.
--the son of Darbhaka and father of Nandivar- dhana. भा. XII. 1. 6, 7.

--on the back of the शिशुमार (s.v.)
1: भा. V. २३. 5.
the southern course. Here are three kinds of sunrise, one in मूल and the other two in two आषाढस्; on its south was पितृयान: consists of three constellations--मूल and आषा- ढस्--पूर्व and उत्तर।
2: Br. II. २१. ७६ & १५९; III. 3. ५१; M. १२४. ५३-8; वा. 1. ९३; ६६. ५१; Vi. II. 8. ८५.
[page१-031+ २८]
--a son of अङ्गिरस् and सुरूपा: a gotrakara. M. १९६. 4.
--one of the ten sons of हृदीक: Father of three powerful sons: सुदम्ष्ट्र, सुनाभ and कृष्ण. M. ४४. ८२-4.
(I)--the son of विधिसार and father of Dar- bhaka (Arbhaka-वि। प्।). भा. XII. 1. 6; Vi. IV. २४. १४-15.

(II)--the son of भूमिमित्र.
1: वा. ९९. ३१७.
His reign lasted for २५ (२७?) years.
2: Br. III. ७४. १३१; M. २७२. १०.
--one of Danu's sons. वा. ६८. 5.
(also अधोमुखस्)--a group of पिशाचस्. Br. III. 7. ३८१; वा. ६९. २६३, २६७.

--an old इतिहास of. A ब्राह्मण of कन्या- kubja, versed in शास्त्रस् and celebrated in आचार। Once when out to get कुश grass, he saw a दासी and fell in love. Then he abandoned all his duties and discarded his wedded wife. The दासी became his wife. She bore him ten sons. The last was named नारायण best loved of his parents. At [page१-032+ ३२] the time of his death, when the messengers of Yama were waiting to remove him to hell, he called out his last son by his name नारायण. On this, the messengers of वीष्णु were on the scene and prevented Yama's men from taking the ब्राह्मन् to hell. It was argued that pronouncing the name of Hari at his death redeemed him of all his sins, and that alone was the secret of Dharma. Yama heard this and approved it. अजामिल, thus rescued from Death, felt peni- tent, and while making तपस् at गङ्गाद्वार, he cast off his body and reached विष्णुलोक। भा. VI. 1. २०. to the end; Ib. VI. ch. 2 & 3.
--a व्रत followed by ऋषभ when he became a mendicant. भा. V. 5. ३२.

--a sage. प्रःलाद saw him one day lying on the bare ground on a cliff of the Sahya hills, and bowed to [page१-149+ २५] him. प्रःलाद asked the sage how he who had no com- forts was able to maintain a sound body. The sage replied that he had renounced all desires, learning renunciation from the bee and contentment from the serpent, while his mind was ever absorbed in Hari. भा. VII. १३. ११-18, २०-45.
--a son of Aja and father of दशरथ. M. १२. ४९.
--the country noted for horses. Br. IV. १६. १७.
